name: luridan
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The luridan is a brownie-like fairy of the Scottish islands. He was recorded in 1665 as a farm hand. He was tied to certain sites, first in Wales and later on the island of Pomonia in the Orkneys. He resembles the ancient Celtic spirit of the place. Like other such fairies he kept the house. He swept and washed the dishes by night and rose early to keep the fire up.

okr.objective: Describe the luridan of the Scottish islands.
